transplants.old_semantics: Six register-primitive UART trait planes with byte-at-a-time transfer and device bitsets.
transplants.new_semantics: One SerialPort element with independently optional operations, pointer+length transfer values and actual-progress counts, named portable values, conditional lifecycle/maintenance, and no endpoint/IRQ/register ownership.
transplants.behavior_delta: The trait planes collapse; config readback, signals, subscriptions, purge, drain, and conditional abort become positive capabilities; raw line-error/event/signal bitsets and legacy traits reject.
transplants.reuse_mode: adapted idioms only; no historical hunk copied verbatim

transplants.old_semantics: PL011-shaped uart_ops/uart_driver_api scaffolds synthesized queue and interrupt policy around single-octet register primitives.
transplants.new_semantics: Queue-neutral Linux pointer+length adapters and capability-gated uart_ops slots; Zephyr polling/FIFO/runtime-config adapters over counted buffers; generic C emits the capability/absence manifest and executes authored behavior.
transplants.behavior_delta: OS framework types remain, but PL011 register policy, IRQ acquisition/scatter, DMA/PIO selection, and device queue ownership are absent. Missing capabilities create no slot and no terminal event or successful fallback.
transplants.reuse_mode: adapted framework slot and include idioms only; old fixture/golden/scatter code excluded

negative_reclassification.locked_disposition: positive capability-gated purge, kept distinct from abort
reclassified to positive counted transmit/receive buffers; the old SerialBulkTransfer trait plane remains rejected
still excluded from serial L1: break, console, and queue/IRQ policy remain backend/L2 or another owner
reclassified to positive capability-gated flow_control_mode data; enforcement remains L2
old const/bitset APIs are oracle-only and remain rejected; their portable meanings are positive named enum or boolean-field values with no raw device-bit carrier
old SerialShutdown plane rejected; close is an ordinary conditional SerialPort capability
rejected below L1 by serial-byte-transfer-reject; locked transfer takes a pointer+length value and returns actual progress

excluded_collateral: PL011 authored fixture and generated goldens
register offsets and register programming policy
DMA/PIO selection and tty/Zephyr queue ownership
